title: Peet’s Coffee
summary: Transforming Peet’s Coffee into a warm, inviting space that blends comfort, style, and an exceptional coffee experience.
body: From detailed coordination to final finishes, the project reflects precision, quality craftsmanship, and alignment with the brand’s rich coffee heritage. A rewarding project that brought together design intent and on-site excellence.

approval.note: Client confirmed MENAARC holds the rights to present this project. Source archive: righteousgrp.com.
